title: Author’s special rights
text:
57. Author’s special rights.—[(1) Independently of the author’s copyright and even after the

assignment either wholly or partially of the said copyright, the author of a work shall have the right—

(a) to claim authorship of the work; and

(b) to restrain or claim damages in respect of any distortion, mutilation, modification or other act

in relation to the said work if such distortion, mutilation, modification or other act would be
prejudicial to his honour or reputation:
